# Tweakpane

> Tweakpane is a compact, dependency-free UI library (TypeScript/JS) for creating parameter panels: sliders, color pickers, folders, tabs, monitors, buttons. This file is a self-contained reference for an AI agent that needs to add Tweakpane UI to a project, exactly as a human developer would, without guessing API signatures.

All snippets below are copied from real source/doc files in this repo (not invented). File paths are given so a human or agent can verify against source.

## Install & basic setup

```sh
npm install --save tweakpane
# Type defs used during development (peer dep of the public types):
npm install --save-dev @tweakpane/core
```

```js
import {Pane} from 'tweakpane';

const pane = new Pane(); // appends itself to document.body
```

```js
const pane = new Pane({
	container: document.getElementById('gui'), // mount point instead of body
	title: 'Parameters',                        // adds a title bar (collapsible)
	expanded: true,                              // initial expanded state of that title bar
});
```

Browser/CDN, no build step:
```html
<script type="module">
  import {Pane} from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tweakpane@4/dist/tweakpane.min.js';
</script>
```

`pane.dispose()` removes the pane's DOM and listeners. `pane.element` is the root `HTMLElement`.

## Core mental model

Everything you add to a `Pane` (or a `Folder`/`TabPage`) is a **Blade**. There are two blade families used 95% of the time:

- **Bindings** (`addBinding`) — bind a property of a plain JS object to a control; the control type is inferred from the value's JS type, and can be overridden with params.
- **Structural blades** (`addButton`, `addFolder`, `addTab`, `addBlade`) — buttons, containers, and free-standing controls not bound to an object property.

`Pane` extends `FolderApi` (via `RootApi`), so a `Pane` has every method a `Folder` has. `TabPageApi` also has the same add* methods. This means folders/tabs/panes are interchangeable containers.

## Adding bindings — `addBinding(object, key, params?)`

```js
const PARAMS = {
	factor: 123,
	title: 'hello',
	color: '#ff0055',
	position: {x: 0, y: 0},
	speed: 0.5,
};

pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'factor');
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'title');
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'color');
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'position');
```

The control type is inferred from `typeof PARAMS[key]` (number → text/slider, string → text, boolean → checkbox, `{x,y}`/`{x,y,z}`/`{x,y,z,w}` → point control, string that looks like a hex/rgba color or object with `r,g,b(,a)` → color picker).

### Common params (all binding types)
```ts
interface BindingParams {
	disabled?: boolean;
	hidden?: boolean;
	index?: number;   // insertion position
	label?: string;   // override the displayed label (defaults to the key name)
	tag?: string;
	view?: string;    // force a specific view, e.g. 'color', 'text', 'graph'
}
```

### Number
```ts
interface NumberInputParams {
	format?: (value: number) => string;
	keyScale?: number;       // scale for arrow-key stepping
	max?: number; min?: number;   // presence of BOTH turns the control into a slider
	pointerScale?: number;   // scale for pointer-drag stepping
	step?: number;
	options?: {text: string; value: number}[] | {[text: string]: number}; // turns it into a dropdown
}
```
```js
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'value', {label: 'slider', min: 0, max: 100});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'speed', {step: 0.1});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'quality', {options: {low: 0, medium: 50, high: 100}});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'value', {format: (v) => v.toFixed(6), label: 'k'});
```
Slider binding returns a `SliderInputBindingApi` with extra `.min`/`.max` getters/setters. Dropdown binding returns a `ListInputBindingApi` with `.options`.

### String
```ts
interface StringInputParams {
	options?: {text: string; value: string}[] | {[text: string]: string};
}
```
```js
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'hex', {view: 'text'}); // force plain text, disable color-string auto-detection
```

### Boolean
```ts
interface BooleanInputParams {
	options?: {text: string; value: boolean}[] | {[text: string]: boolean}; // dropdown instead of checkbox
}
```

### Color
Works on: a hex/rgba **string** value, a numeric value (needs `color:` or `view: 'color'` to be recognized), or an `{r,g,b(,a)}` **object** value.
```ts
interface ColorInputParams {
	color?: {alpha?: boolean; type?: 'int' | 'float'}; // 'int' = 0-255 components, 'float' = 0-1
	expanded?: boolean;   // start with the picker open inline
	picker?: 'inline' | 'popup';
}
```
```js
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'background', {view: 'color'});       // force a numeric value to be a color
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'tint', {color: {alpha: true}});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'overlay', {color: {type: 'float'}});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'key', {expanded: true, picker: 'inline'});
```

### Point2d / Point3d / Point4d
Value shape `{x,y}` / `{x,y,z}` / `{x,y,z,w}`. Each axis accepts the same params as a number (`min`, `max`, `step`, ...); `y` additionally accepts `inverted`.
```js
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'value', {label: 'offset', x: {step: 20}, y: {min: 0, max: 100}});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'value', {label: 'offset', y: {inverted: true}});
```
Point2d also accepts `expanded?: boolean` and `picker?: 'inline' | 'popup'` (2D pad picker).

### Monitors (read-only, `readonly: true`)
```ts
interface BaseMonitorParams {
	bufferSize?: number; // how many samples to remember (default 1, or 64 for a graph)
	interval?: number;   // ms between reads, for live-changing values (e.g. Date.now())
	readonly: true;
}
// number monitor adds: format?, max?, min?, rows?   (view: 'graph' draws a line graph)
// string monitor adds: multiline?, rows?
// boolean monitor adds: rows?
```
```js
pane.addBinding(SHARED_PARAMS, 'wave', {view: 'graph', readonly: true, min: -1, max: 1, label: 'graph'});
pane.addBinding(SHARED_PARAMS, 'wave', {readonly: true, bufferSize: 10});
pane.addBinding(SHARED_PARAMS, 'time', {readonly: true, interval: 1000});
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'log', {readonly: true, multiline: true, rows: 5});
```

## Structural blades

```ts
interface ButtonParams { title: string; label?: string; disabled?, hidden?, index? }
interface FolderParams { title: string; expanded?: boolean; disabled?, hidden?, index? }
interface TabParams   { pages: {title: string}[]; disabled?, hidden?, index? }
```
```js
const folder = pane.addFolder({title: 'Settings', expanded: true});
folder.addBinding(PARAMS, 'factor');

const btn = pane.addButton({title: 'Increment', label: 'counter'});
btn.on('click', () => { /* ... */ });

const tab = pane.addTab({pages: [{title: 'Parameters'}, {title: 'Advanced'}]});
tab.pages[0].addBinding(PARAMS, 'seed');
tab.addPage({title: 'More'});
```
Any container (`Pane`, `FolderApi`, `TabPageApi`) also has:
- `add(bladeApi, index?)` / `remove(bladeApi)` — move/attach an existing blade API
- `refresh()` — force the UI to re-read bound values (call after mutating a bound object outside Tweakpane)
- `.children` — array of child `BladeApi`

### `addBlade` — free-standing (non-object-bound) controls
```js
pane.addBlade({view: 'slider', label: 'brightness', min: 0, max: 1, value: 0.5});
pane.addBlade({view: 'text', label: 'name', value: 'sketch-01', parse: (v) => String(v)});
const list = pane.addBlade({
	view: 'list', label: 'scene', value: 'LDG',
	options: [{text: 'loading', value: 'LDG'}, {text: 'menu', value: 'MNU'}, {text: 'field', value: 'FLD'}],
});
list.on('change', (ev) => { console.log(ev.value); });
pane.addBlade({view: 'separator'});
```
Built into the `tweakpane` package: `view: 'slider' | 'list' | 'text' | 'separator' | 'tab'` (folder/button/tab also work via `addBlade` with the matching params).

## Built-in vendored components (this fork only)

This fork vendors third-party plugins as native built-in components — **no `pane.registerPlugin(...)` call needed**, unlike upstream Tweakpane where each of these would require installing and registering a separate package. Two sources are vendored so far:
- `@tweakpane/plugin-essentials` → `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/blade/{button-grid,cubic-bezier,fps-graph,interval,radio-grid}/`. Docs: `/blades/#buttongrid`, `/blades/#cubicbezier`, `/blades/#fpsgraph`, `/input-bindings/#radiogrid`, `/input-bindings/#interval`.
- `@0b5vr/tweakpane-plugin-rotation` → `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/blade/rotation/`. Docs: `/input-bindings/#rotation`.

```js
// Button grid — addBlade, view: 'buttongrid'
pane.addBlade({
	view: 'buttongrid',
	size: [3, 3],            // [columns, rows]
	cells: (x, y) => ({title: `${x},${y}`}),
	label: 'nav',
});

// Cubic bezier — addBlade, view: 'cubicbezier'
pane.addBlade({
	view: 'cubicbezier',
	value: [0.5, 0, 0.5, 1], // [x1, y1, x2, y2]
	expanded: true,           // start with the curve editor open
	picker: 'inline',         // 'inline' | 'popup'
	label: 'easing',
});

// FPS graph — addBlade, view: 'fpsgraph'; returns FpsGraphBladeApi with begin()/end()
const fpsGraph = pane.addBlade({view: 'fpsgraph', label: 'fps', rows: 2}); // as FpsGraphBladeApi in TS
function render() {
	fpsGraph.begin();
	// ...render work...
	fpsGraph.end();
	requestAnimationFrame(render);
}

// Radio grid — addBinding, view: 'radiogrid' (bind to any scalar value present in `cells`)
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'scale', {
	view: 'radiogrid',
	groupName: 'scale',       // radio <input> group name, must be unique per instance
	size: [3, 2],
	cells: (x, y) => ({title: `${[10, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100][y * 3 + x]}%`, value: [10, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100][y * 3 + x]}),
});

// Interval — addBinding, auto-detected from a plain {min, max} value shape (no `view` needed)
const PARAMS2 = {range: {min: 16, max: 48}};
pane.addBinding(PARAMS2, 'range', {min: 0, max: 100, step: 1}); // min/max/step here constrain the whole range

// Rotation (vendored from @0b5vr/tweakpane-plugin-rotation) — addBinding, view: 'rotation'
// Two representations, chosen by `rotationMode`. Quaternion is the DEFAULT if `rotationMode` is omitted.
pane.addBinding({euler: {x: 0, y: 0, z: 0}}, 'euler', {
	view: 'rotation',
	rotationMode: 'euler',   // must be explicit to get Euler angles
	order: 'XYZ',             // extrinsic rotation order, optional, 'XYZ' by default
	unit: 'deg',               // 'rad' | 'deg' | 'turn', optional, 'rad' by default
});
pane.addBinding({quat: {x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, w: 1}}, 'quat', {
	view: 'rotation',
	// rotationMode: 'quaternion' is implied when omitted
	picker: 'inline',   // 'inline' | 'popup', optional, 'popup' by default
	expanded: true,      // optional, false by default
});
```

## Events

```ts
class TpChangeEvent<T> { readonly value: T; readonly last: boolean; readonly target; } // last=true = drag/edit finished
class TpMouseEvent    { readonly native: MouseEvent; readonly target; }
class TpFoldEvent      { readonly expanded: boolean; readonly target; }
class TpTabSelectEvent { readonly index: number; readonly target; }
```
```js
pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'value', {min: 0, max: 100}).on('change', (ev) => {
	PARAMS.log = ev.value.toFixed(2);
	if (ev.last) { /* user released the slider / blurred the field */ }
});

pane.on('change', (ev) => { /* fires for ANY descendant binding change */ });
pane.on('fold', (ev) => { /* folder/pane collapsed or expanded */ });

const button = pane.addButton({title: 'Go'});
button.on('click', (ev) => { /* ev.native is the raw MouseEvent */ });

const tab = pane.addTab({pages: [{title: 'A'}, {title: 'B'}]});
tab.on('select', (ev) => { console.log('active tab index', ev.index); });
```
`off(eventName, handler)` removes a listener, same signature as `on`.

## Enable/disable, show/hide

Every `BladeApi` (bindings, buttons, folders, tabs, panes...) has:
```js
const b = pane.addBinding(PARAMS, 'input');
b.disabled = true;   // greys out / blocks interaction, keeps it visible
b.hidden = true;      // removes it from layout entirely
b.dispose();           // permanently removes it
```

## Save / load state

There is no `exportPreset`/`importPreset` API. Use `exportState()` / `importState()`, available on `Pane`, any `FolderApi`, `TabPageApi`, or individual blade:
```js
const state = pane.exportState();          // plain JSON-serializable object
localStorage.setItem('pane', JSON.stringify(state));

pane.importState(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pane')));
```
Typical pattern: export on every `'change'` event to persist live, import once at startup.

## Writing a custom plugin

Tweakpane's built-in controls and third-party packages (`@tweakpane/plugin-camerakit`, ...) all use the same public plugin API from `@tweakpane/core`. A plugin bundle is registered with `pane.registerPlugin(bundle)` before it's used. (`@tweakpane/plugin-essentials` is the one common exception in this fork — its components are vendored in as built-ins, see above, no registration needed.)

### Registering an existing plugin package
```js
import {Pane} from 'tweakpane';
import * as CamerakitPlugin from '@tweakpane/plugin-camerakit';

const pane = new Pane();
pane.registerPlugin(CamerakitPlugin);

pane.addBinding({flen: 55}, 'flen', {view: 'cameraring', series: 0});
```

### Writing your own input-binding plugin (minimal, verified pattern)
```ts
// plugin.ts
import {BaseInputParams, BindingTarget, createPlugin, InputBindingPlugin} from '@tweakpane/core';
import {CounterController} from './controller';

type CounterParams = BaseInputParams; // extend with your own custom params here

export const CounterInputPlugin: InputBindingPlugin<number, number, CounterParams> = createPlugin({
	id: 'counter',
	type: 'input',
	accept(value, params) {
		if (typeof value !== 'number') return null;
		if (params.view !== 'counter') return null; // gate on an explicit `view` so it doesn't hijack plain numbers
		return {initialValue: value, params};
	},
	binding: {
		reader: () => (value) => Number(value),
		writer: () => (target, value) => { target.write(value); },
	},
	controller(args) {
		return new CounterController(args.document, {value: args.value, viewProps: args.viewProps});
	},
});
```
```ts
// controller.ts
import {Value, ValueController, ViewProps} from '@tweakpane/core';
import {CounterView} from './view';

export class CounterController implements ValueController<number, CounterView> {
	public readonly value: Value<number>;
	public readonly view: CounterView;
	public readonly viewProps: ViewProps;

	constructor(doc: Document, config: {value: Value<number>; viewProps: ViewProps}) {
		this.value = config.value;
		this.viewProps = config.viewProps;
		this.view = new CounterView(doc, {value: config.value, viewProps: this.viewProps});
		this.view.buttonElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
			this.value.rawValue += 1;
		});
	}
}
```
`view.ts` builds plain DOM (a wrapping `div`, a value preview, a `+` button) — no framework involved, matches Tweakpane's own view files.

```ts
// bundle.ts
import {TpPluginBundle} from '@tweakpane/core';
import {CounterInputPlugin} from './plugin';

export const CounterPluginBundle: TpPluginBundle = {
	id: 'counter',
	plugins: [CounterInputPlugin],
	css: `.tp-counter { /* ... */ }`, // injected once into <head> on first registerPlugin call
};
```
```js
pane.registerPlugin(CounterPluginBundle);
pane.addBinding({count: 0}, 'count', {view: 'counter'});
```

### Plugin type signatures (for reference when writing `accept`/`controller`/`api`)
```ts
interface BladePlugin<P> {
	type: 'blade';
	accept(params: Record<string, unknown>): {params: P} | null;
	controller(args: {blade; document; params: P; viewProps}): BladeController;
	api(args: {controller; pool}): BladeApi | null;
}
interface InputBindingPlugin<In, Ex, P> {
	type: 'input';
	accept(exValue: unknown, params: Record<string, unknown>): {initialValue: Ex; params: P} | null;
	binding: {
		reader(args): (v: unknown) => In;
		constraint?(args): Constraint<In>;
		equals?(v1: In, v2: In): boolean;
		writer(args): (target: BindingTarget, v: In) => void;
	};
	controller(args): ValueController<In>;
	api?(args): InputBindingApi<In, Ex> | null;
}
interface MonitorBindingPlugin<T, P> {
	type: 'monitor';
	accept(exValue: unknown, params: Record<string, unknown>): {initialValue: T; params: P} | null;
	binding: {reader(args): (v: unknown) => T; defaultBufferSize?(params: P): number};
	controller(args): BufferedValueController<T>;
	api?(args): MonitorBindingApi<T> | null;
}
```
A `TpPluginBundle` is `{id, css?, plugin: TpPlugin}` or `{id, css?, plugins: TpPlugin[]}`. `createPlugin(def)` just stamps a `core` version field onto your plugin object — always wrap plugin definitions with it.

## Gotchas for agents generating Tweakpane code

- `addInput`/`addMonitor` are the pre-v4 method names — **v4 uses `addBinding` for both** (direction is inferred from `readonly: true`). Don't emit `addInput`/`addMonitor` for Tweakpane 4.x.
- A number only becomes a slider when **both** `min` and `max` are given; `step` alone does not.
- Forcing `view: 'color'` is required to treat a *numeric* bound value as a color; strings/objects are auto-detected.
- `options` on any input type turns it into a dropdown/list regardless of the base type.
- There's no built-in preset API — build save/load on top of `exportState()`/`importState()`.
- Third-party plugin `view` values only work after `pane.registerPlugin(...)` — using the `view` string without registering silently falls back to the default control (or fails `accept()` and errors). `'fpsgraph'`, `'radiogrid'`, `'cubicbezier'`, `'buttongrid'`, `'rotation'` are the exception **in this fork**: they're built-in (see "Built-in vendored components" above), no registration needed. On unmodified upstream Tweakpane, they'd still require installing the matching plugin package + `registerPlugin`.
- For `view: 'rotation'`, omitting `rotationMode` does **not** mean "auto-detect" — it silently defaults to `'quaternion'`. Passing a plain `{x,y,z}` (no `w`) without `rotationMode: 'euler'` is a bug, not a valid Euler shorthand.
- Package is ESM only (`"type": "module"`); there is no CommonJS build.

## Key source files (this repo, for verification)

- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/index.ts` — full public export list
- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/pane/pane.ts` — `Pane` class, `registerPlugin`
- `packages/core/src/blade/folder/api/folder.ts` — `addBinding`/`addFolder`/`addButton`/`addTab`/`addBlade`
- `packages/core/src/common/params.ts`, `packages/core/src/blade/common/api/params.ts` — every params interface
- `packages/core/src/input-binding/*/plugin.ts`, `packages/core/src/monitor-binding/*/plugin.ts` — built-in binding plugins
- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/blade/{slider,list,text,separator}/plugin.ts` — built-in raw blades
- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/blade/{button-grid,cubic-bezier,fps-graph,interval,radio-grid}/` — built-in essentials (vendored, this fork only)
- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/blade/rotation/` — built-in rotation picker (vendored from `@0b5vr/tweakpane-plugin-rotation`, this fork only)
- `packages/tweakpane/src/main/ts/pane/pane.ts` `setUpDefaultPlugins_()` — the actual list of what's registered by default
- `packages/core/src/blade/plugin.ts`, `input-binding/plugin.ts`, `monitor-binding/plugin.ts`, `plugin/plugin.ts` — plugin authoring interfaces
- `packages/tweakpane/src/doc/ts/plugins/counter/` — full working custom-plugin example
- `packages/tweakpane/src/doc/ts/route/*.ts` — every usage snippet above is adapted from here
